Class FilehandlerPlayer

java.lang.Object
ntnu.gruppe21.filehandler.FilehandlerPlayer
public class FilehandlerPlayer extends Object
Utility class responsible for handling file input and output operations related to Player and each of its attributes.

This class provides functionality for: Saving Player data to CSV files which includes saving Player's Portfolio and TransactionArchive and Loading Player data from a CSV which should include all shares of stock and respective transactions (an others) to form the Players Portfolio and TransactionArchive.

All methods are static and the class is not intended to be instantiated.

  • Method Details

    • savePlayerData

      public static boolean savePlayerData(Player player, String folderPath)
      Saves the current state of an Player to a CSV file in a designated save folder unique to player. Create that folder if not created.

      Similar Function at FilehandlerExchange. Usually invoked on SaveManager

      The file will include: PlayerName, starting money, current money, difficulty, list of shares Portfolio and list of transactions TransactionArchive

      The price history is stored as a semicolon-separated list in a single column.

      Parameters:
      player - Player object to be saved
      folderPath - Full path to saves, provided by SaveManager
      Returns:
      true of false based on if succeed

    • getPlayerSavedData

      public static Player getPlayerSavedData(String folderPath)
      Loads a previously saved Player CSV file in a designated save folder. Usually invoke on SaveManager

      Data is split into paragraphs: First LINE will be the players metadata: Name,startingMoney,currentMoney,difficulty,{challengeType}First paragraph will contain shares: 1,company,symbol,{prices},quantity,purchasePrice; Second paragraph will contain Purchases: 2,company,symbol,quantity,{prices},purchasePrice,week Third paragraph will contain Sales: 3,company,symbol,stock,quantity,{prices},purchasePrice,week

      The first price is used as the initial price when creating the Stock, and the remaining prices are added to reconstruct the full price history.

      Lines starting with '#' and empty lines are ignored.

      Parameters:
      folderPath - Full path, provided by SaveManager
      Returns:
      a reconstructed Exchange object based on the saved data
